# Grok orb web adaptation
Source: https://github.com/ngocdevv/grok-bot-emoji
Pinned commit: c4b9859d5fda157fce28ee729dbeaca1bce1668c
Licence: MIT (original text in LICENSE and public/licenses/grok-bot-emoji-MIT.txt).
Uses the original upstream body and neutral eye vector paths, with a small teal medical cap and bounded pointer-following gaze in a React DOM SVG. CSS provides gentle rotation and blinking instead of the upstream Skia/Reanimated renderer. Reduced-motion users see a still orb. No affiliation with xAI is implied.
